description: The automerge rules of mark1russell7: Renovate merges the low-risk groups when CI passes.

packageRules.description: Renovate merges the npm patch updates when CI passes.
Renovate merges the minor updates of the development dependencies when CI passes.
Before 1.0.0, a minor update can break (SemVer): Renovate never merges it.
Renovate merges the minor, patch and digest updates of the GitHub Actions when CI passes.
Renovate never merges an update of the Claude Code CLI: it changes the program that runs with the API key. A person reviews it.
